newsitem.title: JAPAN: Wakachiku shares up on TSE for sixth straight day.
newsitem.headline: Wakachiku shares up on TSE for sixth straight day.

text.p: Shares in Wakachiku Construction Co Ltd rose on the Tokyo Stock Exchange on Tuesday morning for the sixth consecutive session, attracting investors seeking short-term profits, brokers said.
By 0104 GMT, Wakachiku was up 37 yen, or 6.19 percent, at 635 yen. The issue was the top percentage gainer on the first section of the TSE.
"Wakachiku was up for five trading days days in a row through Monday and its popularity has not faded," an official at a medium-sized brokerage said.

"The biggest reason for the popularity is because its share price moves easily and frequently, although there are also rumours that speculative buying and buying from medium-sized insurance companies is pushing up its prices," he said.
The popularity of its shares is also based on Wakachiku's solid business fundamentals, he added.
Wakachiku is a civil engineering firm.
